summary: All three acceptance criteria are met and nothing is out of scope. AC1: the parametrization fold regex now runs from the first opening bracket to the closing one (DOTALL) and both read_junit and read_junit_cases use it; the new test asserts identity and counts. AC2: the verdict still goes through merge_into; the test asserts one failing nested-bracket case makes the function id fail. AC3: ids without inner brackets match the same span as before. One edge differs: an id with a stray unbalanced closing bracket used to stay unfolded and now folds to the function id, the same bug class. Scope: only the regex and its comment changed in production code.
